brand.name: Kestrel Barber Co.
brand.what: an invented neighbourhood barbershop in Toronto: skin fades, beard sculpting, hot towel shaves
brand.audience: men and teens who want a sharp cut and a good chair

idea: The ritual of a fresh cut. Clippers buzzing in extreme close-up, a fade blending line by line, the hot towel steam rising in slow motion, a straight razor edge-up, the cape whipped off, the client checks the mirror and grins. Confident, rhythmic, clean.
notes: Invented business and people, modest wardrobe, non-medical grooming only. No real brands of clippers or products visible.
